map.代码格式化按层级缩进重建排版：行首缩进宽度 = 当前层级 × 每级空格数。HTM: Formatting rebuilds the layout by indenting each level: leading indentation = current level × spaces per level. HTML/XML compute levels from paired opening and closing tags, so self-closing tags and HTML void elements (br, img, input and so on) do not add depth; CSS computes levels from matched braces, with each declaration placed on its own line. Character count after formatting = original characters + the sum of indentation spaces on each line + the number of line breaks, and the code content itself is never rewritten.
